about.prolog: «Hanamilegal» offers comprehensive legal solutions aimed at sustainable growth, reducing operational risks, and improving the efficiency of your business. Our expertise covers the full spectrum of legal support for entrepreneurial activities:

sections.name: 1. Contractual and pre-contract work
sections.description: We conduct comprehensive due diligence of counterparties, structure contractual models, and support transactions at every stage—from negotiating an offer to the full performance of obligations and the closing of reconciliation acts. We eliminate legal gaps that can lead to financial losses.

sections.name: 2. Comprehensive legal business support (Legal compliance)
sections.description: We provide continuous support for day-to-day operations: we set up an efficient document workflow, organize interactions with government authorities (Federal Tax Service, Rospotrebnadzor, Roskomnadzor, Ministry of Digital Development, Communications and Mass Media, Ministry of Finance of Russia), and handle claims work with counterparties.

sections.name: 3. Litigation and dispute resolution
sections.description: We represent clients in arbitration courts and courts of general jurisdiction at all stages of the process—from filing a claim to the full enforcement of the court decision, including interaction with the bailiff service. We achieve not just rulings, but the actual restoration of violated rights.

sections.name: 4. Corporate document development
sections.description: We develop commercial and corporate agreements “from scratch” for the client's unique needs, prepare legal opinions and strategic memoranda that serve as a reliable foundation for management decision-making.
